title: Itemized Statements on the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
Any patient may request an itemized statement of a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account: a listing of every charge line (date, chargemaster code, CPT or HCPCS code, revenue code, units and charge) and every payment and adjustment on the account.

## Availability

An itemized statement is available once the final bill has dropped; an account still pending billing receives none because its charges are not final. The account's billing status in the system decides availability:

| Account status | Itemized statement |
|---|---|
| pending billing | not available |
| insurance pending, patient due, billing hold, bad debt or closed | available |

## Issue, channel and fee

The statement is issued free of charge within the class's turnaround in business days of the request, counting Monday through Friday and excluding Riverbend holidays, through any channel of the itemized-statement channel list the patient chooses.

## Logging and sequence

Each request is logged as an itemized statement request inquiry and produces one itemized statement with the next itemized sequence number; a repeat request produces a new sequence.

## Collection pause

On request, collection activity beyond the current statement cycle (a further summary statement, the final notice and agency placement) pauses for the class's itemized-statement collection pause, in calendar days from the request.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A patient asks for an itemized statement of an account that already has an itemized statement with sequence 1: the new request is logged and produces sequence 2.
- A patient asks about an emergency visit whose account is still pending billing: no itemized statement is issued for it.
